title: Crownspire Clash: Top 10% Leaderboard Rewards!
body: Hail, Lord Aurelius! The Grand Tournament of Crownspire has concluded. Thanks to your tactical brilliance and defensive tenacity, you secured a position in the Top 10% on the leaderboards. Claim your ancestral tournament rewards below!

title: Winter Solstice Event: Skin Unlocked
body: Greetings, Commander. The Frostfire Citadel event has concluded. For your dedication in burning crystallite cores at the central hearth, you have unlocked the limited Winter Frost Shield skin.
